name: Employment Pay (Ways to Make Money)
description: Free-time jobs from the optional rule Ways to Make Money.

results.name: Minimum Wage Employment
results.description: Minimum Wage Employment — 10–40 hours per week: [[/r (1d43 + 7) * 10]] dollars ($80–500). The GM adjusts by proficiencies.

results.name: Special Employment
results.description: Special Employment — Innate Technique or RCT: CE modifier × d4 × $100 per workweek (roll [[/r 1d4 * 100]] per point of CE modifier). Reverse Technique Prodigy or Mastered Reverse Technique: $10,000 per week.
